∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] (M : Type u_2) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} M] [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} k M]
  [inst_3 : Module.{u_1, u_2} (Polynomial.{u_1} k) M] [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_1, u_2} k (Polynomial.{u_1} k) M]
  [IsAlgClosed.{u_1} k] [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} k M],
  Etingof.IsIndecomposable.{u_1, u_2} (Polynomial.{u_1} k) M →
    Exists.{u_1 + 1} fun lam =>
      Exists.{1} fun n =>
        And (LT.lt.{0} 0 n)
          (Nonempty.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)}
            (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_1} (RingHom.id.{u_1} (Polynomial.{u_1} k)) M
              (Etingof.Example_2_3_14.jordanRep.{u_1} lam n)))

∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] (lam : k) (n : Nat) [NeZero.{0} n],
  Etingof.IsIndecomposable.{u_1, u_1} (Polynomial.{u_1} k) (Etingof.Example_2_3_14.jordanRep.{u_1} lam n)
